cover.title: Capstone review
cover.overview: Re-run completeness on the DITA half and re-read the AEM field log. Fix one issue on each desk.
cover.audience: New writers. Do the work in Oxygen, or on the labeled mock if the app cannot open.

objectives.text: Re-run completeness on the DITA half and re-read the AEM field log. Fix one issue on each desk
Carry out the lab: One fix per desk
Choose the right answer for: Review means watching the videos again. True or not

blocks.body: Re-run completeness on the DITA half and re-read the AEM field log. Fix one issue on each desk.

blocks.heading: What today is
blocks.body: About 90 minutes. Do the lab in the app. The check at the end uses words from today only.

blocks.heading: Review is evidence
blocks.body:
Completeness output. Field log. Two sentences for a teammate. One per desk.

If completeness is already clean, quote the zero. If an alt is missing, write it. Do not skip a desk because it felt finished yesterday.

blocks.heading: Figure
blocks.body: A completeness report next to a field log. Caption: *Both desks. Both pieces of evidence.*

blocks.heading: Do the work
blocks.body:
This lab can fail. Fail when: You skip one desk.

Expected: Quoted completeness. One AEM fix. Two teammate sentences.

blocks.intro: Walk the steps in order. Tick them in the lab after you actually do them.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: Completeness on the capstone map. Quote the report (zero missing links is a valid quote).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: Field log: fix one missing payload or alt.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: Write what you would tell a teammate in two sentences :  one per desk.

blocks.summary: Quoted completeness. One AEM fix. Two teammate sentences.

blocks.q: Review means watching the videos again. True or not?
options: Not true :  review means the completeness report and the field log

blocks.q: Completeness reports zero missing links. What do you write?
options: Quote the zero. That is a valid quote
blocks.why: Zero is a result. Write it down.
